
=== MANA BASE (37 front-face lands + 3 MDFC land-backs, 3 truly tapped) ===
  conditional, not counted: Breeding Pool   [you may pay 2 life]
  conditional, not counted: Morphic Pool   [unless you have two or more opponents]
  conditional, not counted: Overgrown Tomb   [you may pay 2 life]
  conditional, not counted: Undergrowth Stadium   [unless you have two or more opponents]
  conditional, not counted: Watery Grave   [you may pay 2 life]
  TRULY TAPPED: Golgari Rot Farm
  TRULY TAPPED: Opulent Palace
  TRULY TAPPED: Zagoth Triome
  accelerants counted: 14  (restricted, excluded: none)
  rituals counted, play simulation only (net burst): dark ritual +2

--- sources model (colour), worst lines (8000 sims over 3 reps, seed 17) ---
  T6 {U}{U}        71.2% ±0.5   Memory
  T2 {U}{U}        73.3% ±0.1   Counterspell, Mana Drain
  T1 {U}           77.1% ±0.3   An Offer You Can't Refuse, Brainstorm, Mystic Remora
  T1 {G}           80.1% ±0.6   Birds of Paradise, Delighted Halfling, Elvish Mystic
  T1 {B}           81.0% ±0.5   Dark Ritual, Reanimate, Vampiric Tutor

--- play simulation, 20000 trials over 3 reps, seed 17 ---
  line                                             on play     on draw        baseline(any N on TN)
  Memory T6                                      76.6±0.3%   83.6±0.3%     80.7±0.3% / 87.1±0.2%
  Counterspell T2                                54.9±0.2%   61.3±0.8%     93.9±0.2% / 96.0±0.1%
  An Offer You Can't Refuse T1                   67.1±0.3%   70.7±0.2%     97.1±0.1% / 98.3±0.1%
  Birds of Paradise T1                           69.9±0.2%   72.7±0.3%     97.1±0.1% / 98.3±0.1%
  Dark Ritual T1                                 70.0±0.4%   73.3±0.3%     97.1±0.1% / 98.3±0.1%
  Muldrotha, the Gravetide on curve              79.5±0.3%   86.3±0.2%     80.7±0.3% / 87.1±0.2%

  Diagnosis: a line CLOSE to its baseline is a QUANTITY problem (no land swap will help).
  A line FAR BELOW its baseline is a COLOUR problem (a filter land for that pip is the answer).
  A gap smaller than the two ± beside it is noise, not a finding.

  No mulligan is modelled: every opening seven is kept, so the figures above are FLOORS.
  14.4% of opening sevens hold at most one land (2.3% hold none), off 40 lands in 99.
  Those hands are kept here and shipped back in real play. The share moves with
  land count, so it skews deck-to-deck comparison and not just the level.
